activities.activity_description: Complete the remaining work for the DEBS challenge to meet the submission deadline, including finalizing code, testing, and packaging.
Add a new CI build configuration that includes the 'install' target to verify target expectations automatically.
Clean up, document, and publish the XD + Kafka Proof of Concept in the samples repository for use as reference architecture.
Revisit and run performance benchmarks for jdbchdfs with new improvements to verify optimizations.
Bench test cases around TupleBuilder to identify bottlenecks and tune for performance optimizations.

activities.activity_name: GPDB Parameter UX Simplification and Sqoop Testing
activities.activity_description: Simplify the UX around parameters for GPDB to avoid escaping each parameter, and test the Sqoop job with SQLServer and GPDB to identify UX differences.
Migrate module deployment from the 'repository' abstraction (used for stream/job definitions) to a pluggable runtime SPI.
Build an isolated Boot-based ModuleRunner for use in container-managed environments to run XD without the hard requirement for running xd-containers.
